target_pattern: Use preterite for bounded completed events, imperfect for background and habitual context, and apply tense-dependent meaning shifts in conocer, saber, querer, poder, and tener.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Choosing tense by translation only and missing how tense changes verb meaning.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: In narration, imperfect builds the scene and preterite advances events; some verbs switch meaning depending on tense.
target_pattern_formula: imperfect for background, repeated habits, states
preterite for completed event and timeline movement
interruption frame: imperfect action + preterite event
meaning shifts: conocer, saber, querer, poder, tener
continuous nuance: estaba + gerundio vs estuve + gerundio
natural_examples: Cuando era nino, jugaba en ese parque.
Ayer conoci a la nueva gerente.
No sabia la respuesta hasta hoy.
Estaba trabajando cuando sono el telefono.

prompts_en: When I was a child, I always went to the beach.

I was able to lift the box.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as directed.
drills: Base: Cuando era nino, iba a la playa. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Ayer lei un articulo. -> change object to una novela.
Base: Cocinabas cuando sono el telefono. -> change subject to ella.
Base: Estabamos en el parque cuando empezo a llover. -> change location to la oficina.
Base: Juan estaba en el ejercito cuando conocio a Maria. -> change person to yo and object to Carlos.
Base: Ella queria ir, pero no pudo. -> make plural ellos.
Base: Mi papa fumaba todos los dias. -> make it negative.
Base: Visitamos a nuestros abuelos el domingo pasado. -> change day to sabado.
Base: Sabias que Juan mintio? -> change to ustedes.
Base: No sabia que querias ir. -> change to nosotros and vosotros plural meaning ustedes.
Base: Conoci a Ana en 2018. -> change year to 2022.
Base: Maria dijo que conocia a Ana. -> change to yo dije and object to Pedro.
Base: Quise gritar. -> change to refusal meaning with no + querer.
Base: Pude levantar la caja. -> change to imperfect capability meaning with no completed action.
Base: Habia mucho trafico cuando sali de casa. -> change subject to nosotros and verb to llegar al trabajo.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the tense form that matches the intended meaning.
prompts: I met him last year. (Lo conocia el ano pasado. vs Lo conoci el ano pasado.)
I knew him very well. (Lo conoci muy bien. vs Lo conocia muy bien.)
When did you find out? (Cuando sabias? vs Cuando supiste?)
I did not know that. (No supe eso. vs No sabia eso.)
I wanted to call you right then. (Queria llamarte en ese momento. vs Quise llamarte en ese momento.)
I refused to sign. (No queria firmar. vs No quise firmar.)
I managed to open the door. (Podia abrir la puerta. vs Pude abrir la puerta.)
He said he was able/capable on Saturdays. (Dijo que podia trabajar los sabados. vs Dijo que pudo trabajar los sabados.)
I got the impression he was tired. (Tuve la impresion de que estaba cansado. vs Tenia la impresion de que estaba cansado.)
I had the impression he was tired. (Tuve la impresion de que estaba cansado. vs Tenia la impresion de que estaba cansado.)

prompts: Write that when you were in college, you worked at night.

reverse_conceptual_expression.instructions: Write natural Spanish with tense choices that match narrative meaning.
prompts_en: I was reading when she called me.
We met in 2021 but we already knew each other online.
I found out the truth yesterday.
I did not know you were here.
I wanted to shout, but I stayed calm.
I refused to continue the conversation.
I could not finish because there was no time.
He said he could come later.
I got the impression they were nervous.
It had been weeks since we last talked.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Meeting event is confused with ongoing knowing.

common_errors.mistake: Supe que querias venir for ongoing not knowing context
common_errors.why_it_happens: Saber preterite and imperfect meanings are mixed.

common_errors.mistake: No queria firmar used when refusal is completed
common_errors.why_it_happens: Querer imperfect is used for a bounded refusal.

common_errors.mistake: Podia abrir la puerta yo mismo (after successful attempt)
common_errors.why_it_happens: Ability and successful completion are not distinguished.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Pude abrir la puerta yo mismo.

common_errors.mistake: Tenia la impresion in a sudden realization moment
common_errors.why_it_happens: Ongoing state is used instead of received impression.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Tuve la impresion de que estaba cansado.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Background action is switched to event tense.
Scene description gets forced into preterite.
Completed-duration continuous is used instead of interrupted-progress frame.

common_errors.mistake: Hubo mucho trafico cuando salia de casa
common_errors.why_it_happens: Continuous context and punctual event are mismatched.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Habia mucho trafico cuando sali de casa.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Preterite conocer is overextended to ongoing knowledge.
